forum.content_text:
Hello!

I have implemented one of the key parts of a speech recognition system on the STM32N6 without using the cloud. I would like to describe my results in more detail, but it seems to me that the “New Message” section is not the right place for that. Could you please advise me where it would be better to share this?

<https://cdn.embedly.com/widgets/media.html?src=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fembed%2Fj2SjeEnUNBY%3Ffeature%3Doembed&display_name=YouTube&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3Dj2SjeEnUNBY&image=https%3A%2F%2Fi.ytimg.com%2Fvi%2Fj2SjeEnUNBY%2Fhqdefault.jpg&type=text%2Fhtml&schema=youtube>

@unknown wrote:

Hello!

I have implemented one of the key parts of a speech recognition system on the STM32N6 without using the cloud. I would like to describe my results in more detail, but it seems to me that the “New Message” section is not the right place for that. Could you please advise me where it would be better to share this? 

You can post that description in details and you need to share the project, the libraries etc.. from your Github link or just attach it as zip in the post.

Thank you for your contribution.
